statementAccounting.successfulLiveFixture: platform supply, member principal, real persisted prepared evidence and acquired account lease
statementAccounting.baselineMechanism: Only the new batch statement is expanded into eleven original real scalar shared-lock queries through the same real transaction executor; business reads/results are not replaced.
limits: Six counts the method SQL calls through the actual SqlExecutor, excluding BEGIN/COMMIT, observer pg_backend_pid and fixture/coordination SQL; it is not a total protocol-message or network-ACK measurement.

Eleven invocations is supported by the fixed scalar SQL SHA, bound eleven-entry array and eleven returned rows. pg_locks observes unique held/waited keys; it cannot separately count repeated reentrant calls.
The expanded baseline is a focused real per-key-lock baseline, not an execution of an old complete build.

liveAssertions.proofEquivalence: A passing live assertion compares SHA256 of complete type-preserving canonical proof objects, including the sealed encrypted envelope. Proofs, envelope bytes and their comparison digests remain only in heap; no raw proof/envelope or proof digest was exported for independent offline equivalence.

orderedBlocking.observation: Restricted CP coordination-only exclusive locks, actual pg_blocking_pids and pg_locks prove the acquired shared prefix and waiting target; a subsequent unique key remains unheld and independently acquirable when one exists.
orderedBlocking.finalUniqueBoundary: Ordinal 8 is the last unique version key; the two tail entries repeat earlier pool/profile keys.

liveAssertions.cancellation: Actual same-role pg_cancel_backend yields SQLSTATE 57014 while the middle account fence waits. The transaction rolls back the acquired prefix; no pinned core or authority read occurs; the original held lease survives until finally.
normalControlPlaneWriters: Normal ProviderSupplyService account and credential revoke APIs use their real CAS, epochs, audit writes and exclusive locks. A seam pauses only the final real commit; business SQL/results remain real.
A committed account/credential revoke while the reader waits makes the fresh authority read empty and the public proof null after a real core row.
A reader holding shared fences blocks the normal account revoke writer until the complete public read commits; the later fresh public read then refuses.
liveAssertions.roleBoundary: The root asserts each session role is nonsuperuser and verifies original CP/gateway runtime privileges. Production reads use gateway; lifecycle writes use CP; migrator is limited to fixture setup and independent SELECT observations.
liveAssertions.fixtureChain: evidenceAuthorityFixture(migrator,gateway,platform) -> existing normal-success seedFixture(migrator,gateway,mode); no HTTP bootstrap or provider call.

stateAndLeaseScope.comparison: Actual row counts and MD5 of ordered complete row JSON are reduced through type-preserving canonical SHA256 only in heap. Each read/coordination scenario asserts equality before the finally release while its original lease remains held.
stateAndLeaseScope.intendedLifecycleChanges: Platform account, credential and version revocation plus tenant-null CP lifecycle audit rows are separately asserted and are outside the tenant-scoped 17-table digest; this is not a whole-database no-write claim.
stateAndLeaseScope.lease: Each fixture acquires a real maxConcurrency=2, TTL=30000ms lease. finally releases that same original lease object/token and observes the exact tenant/account/upstream/attempt/fencing-token row in released state.
stateAndLeaseScope.fundsBoundary: The fixture commits an actual preparation hold and retains it until owned disposable database teardown. This root does not prove zero open holds, refunds or settlement and does not claim the lease remains held after finally.
